what: Three-way synthetic blind-A/B: live v4-repair vs GLM-4.5-Air raw base vs GLM-4.5-Air + v5 adapter

protocol.contexts: 160 paired real contexts (same set as the 2026-05-31 current-arm run), byte-faithful 3621B product prompt, temp 0.7
protocol.caveat: synthetic proxy only (~69% vs humans ~90.8%); human rating sheet is the gate

training.corpus: data/imessage/voice_training_pairs.jsonl (decode-complete, 1266 pairs, 1202/64 split seed 42; gitignored — real messages)
training.recipe: rank 8, scale 2.0 (verified in adapter_config.json), dropout 0.0, iters 500, lr 1e-5, batch 1, seq 2048, grad_checkpoint
training.speed: 0.88 it/s, peak mem 62.9 GB (M4 Max 128GB, live :8741 co-resident)

verdict: Monotone improvement stack: base pivot is the dominant lever (0.358 -> 0.191), v5 adapter adds on top (-> 0.153, ~1 stderr from the 0.15 indistinguishability proxy bar). Register collapse (lol tell) eliminated at base level.
next_gate: Human rating sheet deployed 2026-07-25 (12 items, ~/.human/blind_ab_human, drip live, ~12 days). Beat v4-repair's human detection 0.75. Promotion is a BASE switch (mlx_local provider config), not an m3_promote adapter hot-swap; depends on mlx-server venv repair.
